days.title: SELECT fundamentals & filtering
tasks: Learn: SELECT, WHERE, AND/OR, IN, BETWEEN, LIKE
Learn: NULL handling (IS NULL, COALESCE), ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT

days.title: Aggregations, GROUP BY, HAVING, CASE
tasks: Learn: GROUP BY vs HAVING, CASE WHEN inside aggregates

days.title: JOINs: inner, left, self, anti
tasks: Learn: INNER vs LEFT vs FULL joins, join cardinality
Learn: self joins and anti joins (LEFT JOIN … IS NULL / NOT EXISTS)

days.title: Subqueries & CTEs
tasks: Learn: scalar, correlated and IN/EXISTS subqueries
Learn: WITH (CTEs), chaining CTEs, recursive CTE basics

days.title: Window functions I: ranking
tasks: Learn: OVER, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY in windows
Learn: ROW_NUMBER vs RANK vs DENSE_RANK, top-N per group

days.title: Window functions II: LAG/LEAD & running totals
tasks: Learn: running totals and moving averages (ROWS BETWEEN)

days.title: Dates, strings, retention & cohorts
tasks: Learn: date functions (DATE_TRUNC, DATEDIFF, intervals), string functions
Learn: retention / cohort query pattern (first-activity date + self join)

days.title: Query optimization
tasks: Learn: how indexes work (B-tree), when they are / aren't used
Learn: read an EXPLAIN plan; filter early, avoid SELECT *, sargable predicates
Practice: rewrite 2 of your earlier solutions to be faster / cleaner

days.title: Data modeling: star schema & SCDs
tasks: Learn: facts vs dimensions, star vs snowflake, grain

days.title: SQL interview patterns + timed mock
tasks: Review: top-N per group, gaps & islands, funnels, dedup with ROW_NUMBER

Weekly review: list weak spots to revisit

days.title: Python fundamentals: types & collections
tasks: Learn: lists, tuples, dicts, sets and comprehensions

days.title: Interview-style problem solving

days.title: Files, JSON/CSV, modules, classes

days.title: NumPy I: arrays & broadcasting
tasks: Weekly review: re-do one Python problem from this week

days.title: NumPy II: vectorization & aggregation
tasks: Learn: vectorized ops vs loops (time both)
Learn: sum/mean/std along axes, argsort, where
Learn: np.random and basic linear algebra

days.title: Pandas I: DataFrames, selecting, filtering
tasks: Learn: Series vs DataFrame, read_csv, head/info/describe

tasks: Code: rewrite 3 of your SQL solutions in pandas
